title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: create and query Planner tasks and plans
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout, licensing and documented neighbouring controls are supported. Minor corrections should flag the preview block API and the Facilitator side effect of disabling Planner Agent, reconcile the membership checklist with the controls table, and update Copilot naming.
